u: Discover HPLIP supported USB, parallel, and network attached printers.

<dl><dt>Bus to probe:</dt><dd>-b<bus> or --bus=<bus> <bus>: cups, usb*, net, bt, fw, par (*default) (Note: bt and fw not supported in this release.)</dd><dt>Set Time to Live (TTL):</dt><dd>-t<ttl> or --ttl=<ttl> (Default is 4).</dd><dt>Set timeout:</dt><dd>-o<timeout in secs.> or --timeout=<timeout is secs.></dd><dt>Filter by functionality:</dt><dd>-e<filter list> or --filter=<filter list> <filter list>: comma separated list of one or more of: scan, pcard, fax, copy, or none*. (*none is the default)</dd><dt>Search:</dt><dd>-s<search re> or --search=<search re> <search re> must be a valid regular expression (not case sensitive)</dd><dt>Network discovery method:</dt><dd>-m<method> or --method=<method>: <method> is 'slp'* or 'mdns'.</dd><dt>Set the logging level:</dt><dd>-l<level> or --logging=<level> <level>: none, info*, error, warn, debug (*default)</dd><dt>Run in debug mode:</dt><dd>-g (same as option: -ldebug)</dd><dt>This help information:</dt><dd>-h or --help</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>Find all devices on the network:</dt><dd>hp-probe -bnet</dd><dt>Find all devices on USB that support scanning:</dt><dd>hp-probe -busb -escan</dd><dt>Find all networked devices that contain the name 'lnx' and that support photo cards or scanning:</dt><dd>hp-probe -bnet -slnx -escan,pcard</dd><dt>Find all devices that have queues installed in CUPS:</dt><dd>hp-probe -bcups</dd><dt>Find all devices on the USB bus:</dt><dd>hp-probe</dd></dl>
HPLIP (HP Linux Imaging and Printing) is an HP developed solution for printing, scanning, and faxing with HP inkjet and laser based printers in Linux.
The HPLIP Launchpad.net site https://launchpad.net/hplip is available to get help, report bugs, make suggestions, discuss the HPLIP project or otherwise contact the HPLIP Team.
